title: Mass lower bound e^{-Λρ}ω_nρ^n ≤ μ_V(B_ρ(x)) from the monotonicity formula 8.3.3 at a point of density ≥ 1
statement: Assume the frozen contract proposition MonotonicityFormula (Simon 8.3.3). Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation. Let x ∈ ℝ^N, let ρ₀ > 0 with B°_{ρ₀}(x) ⊆ U, and let Λ ≥ 0 with ‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) ≤ Λ·μ_V(B_ρ(x)) for all 0 < ρ < ρ₀ (‖δV‖ = variationMeasure V). Suppose Θ^n(μ_V, x) exists and equals θ with θ ≥ 1 (HasDensity n μ_V x θ). Then e^{-Λρ}·ω_n·ρ^n ≤ μ_V(B_ρ(x)) for every 0 < ρ < ρ₀; in ℝ≥0∞, ofReal(exp(-(Λρ))) * unitBallVolume n * ofReal(ρ)^n ≤ V.weight (closedBall x ρ).
lean_statement: MonotonicityFormula → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ₀ Λ : ℝ) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → 0 < ρ₀ → ball x ρ₀ ⊆ U → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * V.weight (closedBall x ρ)) → HasDensity n V.weight x θ → 1 ≤ θ → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Λ * ρ))) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n ≤ V.weight (closedBall x ρ)
